risk_assessment.rationale: The email originates from unknown domains and addresses associated with the MITRE ATT&CK T1566 phishing tactic, yet insufficient contextual evidence limits certainty; this high-risk level 5 alert requires analyst review. Recommended actions include blocking the source IP, isolating the host, escalating to incident response, reviewing authentication logs, scanning for malware, and preserving evidence for further investigation.

recommended_actions: Block the source IP at the network perimeter
Isolate the affected host from the network pending investigation
Escalate to the incident response / Tier 2 team
Review authentication logs for this account over a wider time window
Run an antivirus/EDR scan on the affected host
Preserve logs and evidence for the affected host pending further investigation
Notify the asset owner of the affected host or agent
Verify whether the source IP/user is a known, expected service account or automation
Correlate this indicator against the wider environment beyond this alert's time window
recommended_actions_freeform_experimenta: Enrich all domains and IPs through threat intelligence feeds to identify reputation scores or known malicious indicators.
Cross-reference the sender's email address and subject line with historical phishing campaigns targeting similar industries or entities.
Check for any internal user reports or alerts related to invoice payment requests from external senders.
Validate whether the victim corporation (victimcorp.com) has any existing integrations with Mimecast or other email security providers.
Assess if the compromised account (jane.tan@victimcorp.com) has been previously targeted in spear-phishing attempts.
Monitor for lateral movement indicators, such as unusual outbound traffic from the victim's network post-compromise.
